general_summary: Rui Grazina designs his architecture, products, furniture from his studio in Porto. His architecture includes new build houses and extensions across northern Portugal. Since 2002 the Rui Grazina studio has produced a range of furniture and products exhibited at 100% Design, London, Fet á Portugal/FAD, Barcelona, Remade in Portugal and Design+, Lisbon. Jewellery box RG02 won the design competition for the Berardo Modern Art Collection Museum Design Shop, Lisbon. In November 2010 Rui presented his work at Rio de Janeiro Design Week, Brazil and launched his new product RG05 in December exclusively at Elements Contemporary Jewellery, in Porto . He was selected and will exhibit at the ‘Talents’ section of Ambiente, Frankfurt in February 2011. Prior to 2000 Rui worked as an architect on a wide range of projects in London and Porto. He completed his education at the Faculty of Architecture, University of Porto. He was born in Maputo, Mozambique.

general_summary: PLAN Associated Architects, based in Quinta do Lago, Algarve, Portugal, is a multidisciplined architectural practice specialized in architecture, urban and town planning and interior design, which also offers a vast range of services in areas so diverse as design, environmental impact studies and others, as result of close partnerships with qualified companies. 20 Years of experience have shaped each stroke we draw and enriched our team, but our main focus is directed towards the future and all the new projects and challenges that await us. PLAN Associated Architects was founded in 1991 and is based in the luxury resort of Quinta do Lago, Algarve, Portugal. A multidisciplinary team specializing in the areas of architecture, town planning & urban design and interior design is prepared to act in all stages of the project. Each project is unique and we make it a point to keep our minds open to new concepts and the needs of an ever-changing society, creating a balance between aesthetics, functionality, innovation and sustainability.
